subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should the permanent Plugin SDK expose a generic finalized AgentToolResult.control seam for runtime actions, or a narrower yield-specific contract?
rationale: This adds an unshipped external plugin API and host callback whose ownership, extensibility, and compatibility obligations cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve the generic control seam
options.body: Keep AgentToolResult.control as an extensible host-owned union, document its compatibility contract, and land after the catalog scheduling defect is fixed.

options.title: Narrow to yield-only API
options.body: Expose a dedicated yield result and host handler without establishing a general-purpose result-control extension point.

options.title: Defer the SDK surface
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader interaction roadmap establishes the long-term plugin-to-runtime control boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic control seam
recommendation.body: Keep AgentToolResult.control as an extensible host-owned union, document its compatibility contract, and land after the catalog scheduling defect is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the existing sessions_yield lifecycle that defines the runtime behavior this public SDK would expose.
